join_path_requirements.name: transactions_to_ledger_entries_left
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports intentionally unposted transactions and Transaction-to-Ledger LEFT JOIN questions.

join_path_requirements.name: ledger_entries_to_transactions
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports transaction attributes for posted ledger lines.

join_path_requirements.name: ledger_entries_to_accounts
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports account-level debit, credit, and balance analysis.

join_path_requirements.name: budgets_to_accounts
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports account and account-type budget analysis.

join_path_requirements.name: accounts_to_parent_accounts
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports chart-of-accounts hierarchy and root-account questions.

join_path_requirements.name: transactions_to_fx_rates
join_path_requirements.join_condition: transactions.source_currency = fx_rates.from_currency AND transactions.target_currency = fx_rates.to_currency AND transactions.transaction_date = fx_rates.rate_date
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports deterministic FX lookup by source, target, and effective date.

join_path_requirements.name: transactions_to_available_fx_rates
join_path_requirements.join_condition: transactions.source_currency = fx_rates.from_currency AND transactions.target_currency = fx_rates.to_currency AND transactions.transaction_date = fx_rates.rate_date AND fx_rates.rate IS NOT NULL
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports FX-adjusted SUM questions over convertible transactions.

join_path_requirements.name: transactions_to_missing_fx_rates
join_path_requirements.join_condition: transactions.source_currency = fx_rates.from_currency AND transactions.target_currency = fx_rates.to_currency AND transactions.transaction_date = fx_rates.rate_date AND fx_rates.rate IS NULL
join_path_requirements.purpose: Exercises the intentional NULL FX-rate imperfection without removing lookup rows.

join_path_requirements.name: transactions_to_ledger_entries_to_accounts
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports the required three-table accounting path and rolling balances.

join_path_requirements.name: budgets_to_preaggregated_actuals
join_path_requirements.join_condition: Budget periods LEFT JOIN pre-aggregated USD actuals by account_id and start-inclusive/end-exclusive transaction date.
join_path_requirements.unmatched_condition: Pre-aggregated actual amount is NULL for the budget account and period.
join_path_requirements.purpose: Supports budget-versus-actual analysis, including periods with no actuals.

accounting_rules: Each ledger-backed transaction must have equal debit and credit totals.
Each debit and credit total must equal the source transaction total_amount.
Exactly one of debit_amount and credit_amount must be populated and positive per ledger row.
Ledger currency_code must equal the source transaction source_currency.
Reversed transactions swap debit and credit orientation without a second rolling-balance multiplier.
Line numbers must be sequential and unique within each transaction.
conversion_rules: Every transaction source/target/date key must match exactly one FX row.
USD/USD rows must always contain rate 1.000000.
A matched FX row with a NULL rate is intentionally unconvertible, not an orphan.
FX conversion multiplies first and rounds once to monetary scale 4 using ROUND_HALF_UP.
Boundary-date transaction FX rows must remain populated.
consistency_rules: All account numbers and primary keys must be unique.
The account hierarchy must be acyclic and root accounts must retain NULL parent_account_id values.
Account subtype and normal balance must agree with account type.
Every physical foreign key must reference an existing parent row.
Exactly five percent of base transactions must remain without ledger entries.
At least one transaction must post to multiple accounts and at least one account must receive multiple transactions.
Transaction posted_at must be on or after transaction_date within the configured lag.
Budget periods must be valid, deterministic, and non-overlapping per account and scenario.
Budget and target currencies must use USD; source and ledger currencies must use the configured currency set.
FX rows must form the complete configured currency-pair/date grid and preserve composite uniqueness.
Only budgets may gain rows during imperfection injection.
All monetary values use scale 4 and populated FX rates use scale 6.
